literal_meaning: দীর্ঘজীবী কাক বা পাখি (a long-lived crow)
figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastic meaning - long-lived; much experienced; worldly-wise and cunning person
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি ভুশণ্ডির মতো বহু বছর বেঁচে সবকিছু দেখে ফেলেছেন।
এই বুড়ো ভুশণ্ডি কথায় কথায় সব জানে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has lived like a bhushundi crow and seen everything over the years.
This old bhushundi knows everything just by talking.
history: The idiom derives from Bengali folklore where the crow (bhushundi) is depicted as a long-lived bird symbolizing accumulated wisdom and cunning through age.
note: Variants may reflect regional pronunciations in Bengali dialects.
